messages:
maria: npm audit just popped a high for postcss in console/ui build. CVE-2026-1234 flagged via css-loader -> postcss chain, looks like prototype-pollution style. any objections to prioritizing a patch?
ajay: can you paste the audit snippet?
maria: ```\n{\n  \"advisory\": \"CVE-2026-1234\",\n  \"module\": \"postcss\",\n  \"severity\": \"high\",\n  \"path\": \"console-ui > webpack > css-loader > postcss\"\n}\n```
samir: rough triage: postcss runs at build-time on CI (node) not in-browser runtime. expoitable only if untrusted CSS is processed on CI or during runtime processing server-side. our console UI compiles static assets from repo sources — low direct exploit surface, but still need to fix.
kyle: agreed. we should avoid leaving high sev findings open. upstream has a patch in postcss@8.4.17 according to their changelog.
ajay: tried upgrading locally to 8.4.17 and autoprefixer needed bump too. doing a lockfile-only change rewrites pnpm-lock.yaml heavily and caused a few transient CI failures on node18 vs node20 matrix. also hit one tsc error due to @types/postcss moving types around.
maria: thanks — so options: 1) full upgrade (postcss+autoprefixer + types) and run CI, accept lockfile churn, 2) add package.json "resolutions" / pnpm overrides to pin postcss to patched version (less churn), 3) patch our build to vendor a small shim to avoid processing untrusted inputs (more engineering). Preference?
samir: prefer 1 for correctness, but if churn will block many teams we can do 2 as interim and follow with 1. Document audit exception if we go the override route.
ajay: commands I used: ```\npnpm up postcss@8.4.17 autoprefixer@10.4.14 --lockfile-only\npnpm install --frozen-lockfile\n# then run \npnpm -w -r test:ci\n```\nNote: after the lock update I had to bump @types/postcss to 8.4.3 to satisfy tsc.
kyle: if we do override, add a short note in the release notes and a security tracker entry (audit suppressed until full upgrade). ops: will this affect Dedicated/private builds? those use same build image so yes.
maria: plan proposal: open PR with lockfile-only bump to postcss+autoprefixer + types, run full CI. If tests fail due to unrelated churn, fall back to adding resolution and a followup ticket to finish full upgrade. aim: patch release for console-ui this week.
ajay: I'll validate the PR and run manual builds on node18/20 tomorrow.
devsec-bot: security-scan: postcss CVE-2026-1234 -> remediation in progress (assigned: ajay).
kyle: timeline ok with me, please tag security when PR is up. :eyes:
maria: I'll open the PR now and assign to @ajay. tagging security and product for awareness. ETA 48h for patch + possible backport to v1.2.x if CI green.
ajay: got it — will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
